name: Private Clay Burkett
want: get home to Georgia with something to show for it
secret: He means to desert at the next payday with a horse and two friends, and has told Nell Haskins.
description: A Confederate prisoner who enlisted in the Union army to get out of the prison camp at Rock Island, and was sent to guard the plains.
appearance: A uniform too big for him, a grin, a harmonica in his breast pocket.
